|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Add one battle destiny during a battle at any Trash Compactor, Incinerator, Junkyard, or swamp.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Add one battle destiny at Incinerator, Trash Compactor, Watto’s Junkyard, or a swamp.” '''What changed:''' removed “during a battle”; “any” → “Incinerator,”; “Incinerator,” → “Watto’s”; added “a”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 10. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_10.
